## `convertIntervalNotation`

*Available in [R](#convertintervalnotation-r)*
=== "R"
    !!! bug "Deprecated Function"
        This function has been deprecated, and will be removed in a future CIDAtools release.
    <h4>Description</h4>

    Converts a vector from Interval Notation to less than equal to, less than,
    etc.

    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```R

    convertIntervalNotation(x)

    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `x` - a character vector to be converted

    <h4>Returns</h4>

    a character vector of same length of x converted
